criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Frames 2, 3 and 9 are strong interiors, frame 1 a credible cover, frame 7 carries the argument. Frame 6 exposes the fly model (spheres, bead eyes, grey disc wings, cork stool food), with a full-height seam and a dead middle left. Frame 5 has sprite trees on a flat dark plain and a cropped giant vial with streaked glass. Frame 4 is a sheet pinned to a flat wall. The hero is small on 2, 4 and 9. Exterior golden hour reads grey dusk, glass shows streaks on 1, 7, 8. Frame 2 shows no window and no floor junction.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: Clearly one deck with two working continuity devices and landing bookends. Undeclared 3 to 4 step, room light direction not held between 2 and 3, frame 8 reads as frame 1 repeated.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces, bar ratio matches, primary sources, frame 5 careful. The caption compresses c39's individuals into families.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who, where and what to do, no invented deadline. The stake is concrete only for the narrow set of families with an undiagnosed rare disease.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover says the whole turn, frame 2 pays, 9 closes on an action. Frame 8 is softest, repeating frame 1.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Plain and honest with good lines. Frame 9's dek opens on inverted eligibility syntax. Texas specificity stops at Houston.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Fresh subject. goldenHour reused from no. 37, accent near no. 39's green, opening move repeats nos. 37 and 39.

one_sentence_fix: Remodel the fly and re-shoot frame 6 without the seam and the dead middle left, and replace frame 5's sprite trees and grey plain with the sunlit coping itself.
